notes.title: Improved texts
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4wnkvHz.jpg [/img]
[b]Hi guys, [/b]
It's been a while, huh?

Our publisher [b]Drageus Games[/b], who ported game for [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/tardy-switch]Nintendo Switch[/url], also helped us to improve [b]english[/b] texts. 

We hope native speakers will have more pleasant experience now.

Thanks [b]everybody[/b], who played our game and gave feedback! That was a wonderful year because of you.

And we believe the future will be even more interesting.

Thank you, guys! You're the best.

notes.title: Tardy goes to Linux!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, guys![/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zaKokD1.png[/img]
We’re glad to release [b]Linux-version[/b] today! We hope you’ll enjoy it!

‘Cicada’ will continue to work on Tardy. We’ll try to show our project to a larger audience and make it better.   

[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: Tardy OSX version!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, everyone! [/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FnfomXg.jpg[/img]
We glad to announce that Tardy will be released on [b]OSX today![/b] We are looking forward to new players in our game.
Also, Linux-version is coming soon! Keep in touch ;) 
Thank you all for your attention and your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello!

We fixed a couple more things:
[list]
[*]Fixed minor text errors in the Russian version
[*]Fixed the problem, due to which fonts were too small in some resolutions
[*]Fixed a bug due to which some players can't see main menu
[*]Fixed the problem with the loading of chapters
[/list]
Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi!

We've read your feedback and made a few more changes.

List of changes:
[list]
[*]Puzzle with the search for login / password has become more logical
[*]Fixed puzzle with ventilation
[*]Key objects in the dark room now glow
[*]Fixed a bug at the end of the second chapter
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback! With your help, the game gets better!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 1.0.1[/b]

Hi, everyone!

We’ve read the first reviews and made a couple of edits that will make the game better.

Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some localization mistakes
[*] Fixed bug with envelope
[*] Fixed a mini-game interface
[/list]

Please, tell us about what you like and what prevents you from enjoying the game. This will help us to make the game better!

Thank you!
